verdict.rationale: Exa documents a dedicated Answer endpoint, priced at $5 per 1k requests, described as "An LLM answer to a question, with citations" [exa-docs-46]. The official exa-js SDK shows a one-call `exa.answer(...)` labeled "Get answers with citations" [exa-gh-8, exa-gh-3]. Deep Search also returns multi-step research with citations [exa-docs-45]. Missing for 10: a dedicated Answer API reference describing the citation/response format and options, and independent hands-on corroboration of answer quality and sourcing.
